title: Parking for 1,000,000 Cars
caption:
Parking for 1,000,000 Cars 🚗
One million cars need one parking spot. A giant tower, a ferris wheel of cars and a queue a mile long. Every problem gets a fix until the counter hits a million.

Would you park here every day? Comment below. Tag a friend who would. Follow @StickMindR8 for the next build.
